sentences.text: Edna Hollis (S2) reported that her hip is stiff in the mornings and she now uses a frame in the house.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated she does not go out without someone.
Edna Hollis (S2) reported that carers Jade (morning) and an unnamed teatime carer visit her.
Edna Hollis (S2) described the teatime carer as being 'in and out' quickly.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated she cannot get to the post office and her grandson Kyle goes to the cash machine for her.
Edna Hollis (S2) reported she does not put the heating on during the day, only when someone is coming.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated that at the end of the month she has toast for dinner because there is nothing left.
Edna Hollis (S2) expressed a wish that Kyle does not get in trouble and she does not want the police involved.
Edna Hollis (S2) denied that Kyle has threatened her or hurt her.
Edna Hollis (S2) reported her daughter Sandra says Kyle gambles on his phone with betting things.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated she has never seen Kyle gamble.
Edna Hollis (S2) confirmed Kyle uses her bank card.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated Kyle takes £50 from her bank card every week for himself.
Edna Hollis (S2) reported she does not say anything about the £50 withdrawal because she sees it on the statement.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated her daughter Sandra does a shop on a Saturday when she can.
Edna Hollis (S2) reported that £400 was in her purse for Christmas presents and was gone after Kyle visited three weeks ago (Sunday).
Edna Hollis (S2) stated Kyle told her he was borrowing the money and would pay it back, and she believes it is not stealing.
Edna Hollis (S2) confirmed Sandra knows about the £400 in the purse but she is cross about it.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated she has not told Sandra about the bank card.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated she would ring the social worker on the duty line if Kyle asks for money before Thursday and she is worried.
Edna Hollis (S2) requested the social worker write the meeting time on her calendar.
